Job Description Introduction About The Team The Connect UI team builds the experiences Confluent Cloud customers use to bring data into and out of Kafka. That covers browsing and setting up fully managed and custom connectors, troubleshooting connector failures with AI assistance, and visualizing how connectors are performing. Connectors are where customers real-time data enters the platform, so the quality of what we build directly affects how quickly customers get up and running About The Role We are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who's excited to help build engaging, intuitive products for managing and visualizing large-scale, real-time data streams. Data flow is central to how companies operate, and we aim to make that experience simple and attractive. Working with mentorship from senior engineers, you will help develop features across the Connect experience in Confluent Cloud and steadily grow into an owner of parts of the product. Our Cloud UI is built with React and TypeScript on our own design system, and connects to multiple REST and GraphQL APIs. We test with Jest and React Testing Library (unit) and Playwright (end-to-end). We deploy to production daily and can test every commit, including PRs, before it goes live. Feature flags let us release independently of backend teams, and bots keep our dependencies up to date. AI-assisted development tools are part of our everyday engineering workflow. Your Role And Responsibilities As a Frontend Software Engineer, you will help build client-side features for data-intensive products, working closely with senior engineers, designers and product managers. You Will Help develop new features from user requirements and designs, taking on well-defined tasks within larger features, delivering them on time, refining them based on feedback, and growing the scope you own over time. Build UI components and interactions to the design specifications using our design system, and integrate with backend APIs, working with backend engineers to understand API contracts and handle loading, error and empty states well. Write clean, readable code with unit and end-to-end tests, and write short design notes for your tasks for peer review. Take part in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback. Help investigate and fix bugs and production issues, starting by shadowing the on-call rotation. Share your progress clearly in standups and project updates, and raise blockers early. Learn Confluent's engineering practices, including release, monitoring and feature flag processes, and how our product works end to end. Preferred Education Master's Degree Required Technical And Professional Expertise Experience with 0.6 –1 year of professional experience and a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms and problem-solving Strong JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming (promises, async/await), closures and the DOM, plus solid HTML and CSS skills, including responsive layouts A good understanding of React (components, props, state, hooks, and how components re-render) and a basic understanding of frontend architecture: structuring components, managing state, and separating data fetching from UI Experience building and bundling a frontend project with Webpack or a similar tool such as Vite, including an understanding of modules, loaders and code splitting Comfort debugging with browser developer tools, and familiarity with Git and a pull-request-based workflow Curiosity, eagerness to learn and openness to feedback, with good communication and collaboration skills and a team-first mindset Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Awareness of web accessibility and web performance (for example, bundle size and Core Web Vitals) Experience with data visualization or charting libraries Exposure to AI-powered workflows, agentic AI or LLM-based applications Internships, open-source contributions, hackathons or personal projects you've built and shipped Interest in data streaming, Kafka or distributed systems (no prior experience needed)

description: Company: **Midad Arabia** Job Title: **ERP QA Tester** – **Accounting & Finance Specialist** Department: **Quality Assurance / Software Testing** Experience: **Entry-level** (Freshers can apply) Employment Type: **Full-time** **1.⁠ ⁠About Midad Arabia** Midad Arabia provides ERP solutions and business software that help companies improve operational efficiency, manage their finances, and increase profitability. We are looking for a motivated ERP QA Tester with strong accounting fundamentals and an interest in software testing to ensure our ERP system is accurate, reliable, and ready for real-world business use. **2.⁠ ⁠Job Summary** We are looking for an entry-level ERP QA Tester who combines accounting knowledge with software testing skills. The ideal candidate should understand basic accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, financial statements, taxation, inventory accounting, and business workflows. The candidate will test ERP modules, validate accounting entries generated by business transactions, identify software defects and financial discrepancies, and ensure that business processes function correctly. The successful candidate will receive opportunities to develop expertise in ERP testing, accounting validation, and end-to-end business process testing. **3.⁠ ⁠Key Responsibilities** **A. India is the world's second-largest producer of fruits and vegetables, and loses over a lakh crore rupees of it every year between the farm and the shelf. Every day we source from farms, then ripen, grade, pack and deliver fresh produce, using technology and data to improve quality, ensure consistent supply, minimise wastage and bring predictability to pricing. Around 100 people run the chain end to end, and the business is profitable. Our harvest-handling rig cut bruising from around 30% to around 3%. Systems for farm selection, field scanning, produce movement and a fully automated packhouse are in build and design, with IISc and partner engineering firms. Five patent applications are filed. Everything is built in three layers: a physical layer that moves and conditions produce, a sensing layer that reads its state, and an intelligence layer that decides what happens next and learns from the result. The crop changes. The architecture stays. **The role** We are building a high-quality software engineering team to own the sensing and intelligence layers, and the applications that run the business around them. Title and responsibility will match experience. • Solid programming fundamentals and problem-solving skills in at least one language. • A working understanding of databases, web applications and APIs, and the ability to debug code you did not write. • Someone who learns fast, goes deep rather than skimming, works around obstacles and stays steady when priorities change – humble enough to be trained from scratch, confident enough to question what does not make sense. • You do not need to be from a top-tier college. **What to know before you apply** This is an on-site role at our facility in Cheemasandra, Bengaluru East, six days a week, with no remote or hybrid option – the machines you will work on are here. It is the fastest way we know to become an exceptionally capable engineer. **Why join us** • Your code runs real machines and a real supply chain the moment it is ready – no release queues, no waiting months to see your work in use. • Patented systems co-developed with IISc and engineering firms, not another CRUD app. • Learn AI-assisted development in your first job, not your fifth. • Real ownership from your first month, working close to a founder who spent 18+ years in software and data systems before building this company. • Grow as fast as you can prove yourself. Job description Job Summary eGov Young Leaders Program 2026 About eGov Foundation eGov Foundation exists to improve peoples quality of life by ensuring that every citizen of this world has access to timely, efficient and effective public services. Through our open digital infrastructure and a strong global network, we are reimagining how governments deliver services across local governance services, sanitation, health, etc. For the last 20 years, we have been a catalyst for transforming services in 10+ countries, touching the lives of over 2 billion citizens. The Role We are looking for driven accountable , high performing individuals who can wear multiple hats and have the ability to self-start. This program is designed to provide the cohort a practical insight into what it takes to get systemic impact on the ground. This is a 2 Year Long rotational program across various tracks [detailed below], carefully curated to give young leaders a crash course in practicing impact. This programme will enable you to assess where your strengths lie and give you an exposure to not just diversify your skillset but also to learn from some of the smartest people in these fields. Detailed Tracks Institutional Partnerships and Fundraising: Understanding how different institutions (governments, foundations, CSR arms, multilaterals, corporates) shape and fund systemic change, and how to build relationships with them. May or may not involve raising money directly. Organizational Strategy: Defining where an organization is headed and how it gets there: vision, theory of change, priorities, structure, and resource allocation. Focuses on the big choices that keep the organization coherent and sustainable as it scales. Program Capability: Building the ability to design, deliver, and improve programs that produce real outcomes on the ground. Covers program design, implementation quality, measurement, and learning loops. Network Capability: Strengthening how an organization builds and works with a web of partners, communities, and peer organizations to drive change collectively. Covers ecosystem mapping, coalition building, and collaboration models that no single organization could achieve alone. Product Capability Consulting: Developing the skills to build and manage products (digital tools, platforms, or service offerings) that solve user problems at scale, and to advise others on doing the same. Blends product thinking with a consulting mindset of diagnosing needs and recommending solutions. Exposure to social impact work is not mandatory, we are just looking for people who are looking to contribute to the society and truly believe that they can make a difference. Who are we looking for Humility, maturity, high accountability, willingness to learn and excellent critical thinking skills are imperative to excel in this role. If you are someone who enjoys a challenge but also knows when patience is the way to go - you are a great fit! Passionate about working in the social impact space. Open to folks with 0-3 years of experience, willing to relocate to Bangalore. eGov believes in the power of mentorship and we are happy to work with you , as long as you bring in the right energy! Good luck dear changemakers! Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change.
